note: Row, row-group, column-group, and cell border contributions resolve per the spec's precedence: a 5px row border beats the cells' 1px tops on row 2, the thead's 3px border contributes the outer frame of row 1 and loses to the wider tbody border at the section boundary, and the colgroup's 4px border-right paints the table's right edge on rows the row borders don't cover. Struts take half of the widest collapsed outer border on each side.
